landmark_annotation.coordinate_space: Original native1254square; origin top-left, xright/ydown. No PNG cropping, filtering, packing or resizing performed.
landmark_annotation.method: Manual visual landmarks with conservative error estimates. Read-only Pillow/numpy alpha run-connected-components supply full silhouette bounds plus4px antialias padding. Native source is preserved bitwise.
landmark_annotation.foot_definition: Arithmetic mean of TWO visible/estimated sole-contact center points, not lowest single boot pixel. Rear boot occlusion explicitly marked; moving raised soles use projected sole points.
landmark_annotation.hair_definition: Top of visible chestnut hair excluding broad hat and staff, hand estimated. Warm-pixel ROI scan is corroboration only and can include warm rim detail; it does not replace semantic annotation.
landmark_annotation.muzzle_definition: Top visible glowing central violet crystal tip, excluding highest silver crown point.
landmark_annotation.staff_tip_definition: Highest pointed silver crown tip of staff, separate from crystal/muzzle.
landmark_annotation.normalization: None. Runtime must apply one A-idle direction scale to all8poses. B references matching-direction A; dash/guard retain naturally reduced height, no perpose enlargement.
landmark_annotation.head_scale_review: A9 visually approved A/B camera distance and head proportions; this is candidate visual review, not calibrated size equality.
